newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro says oilfields normal after shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro says oilfields normal after shutdown.

text.p: Crude output at the North Sea Oseberg and Brage developments was running normally on Tuesday following stoppages for annual maintenance, operator Norsk Hydro ASA said.

Oseberg Field Centre was shut in June 8, together with Oseberg C, Oseberg West and the Brage fields. Oseberg C was brought back onstream on Sunday night, while Field Centre and Brage resumed pumping on Monday.
"Everything is back to normal," a spokeswoman for the company said.
In May, combined output from Oseberg Field Centre and Oseberg West was 346,611 barrels per day (bpd), while Oseberg C produced 148,576 bpd and Brage 104,939 bpd.
